rendering: React AST; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML or rehype-raw. Model HTML is escaped text.

katex.override: All plugins share the patched direct KaTeX version, avoiding vulnerable nested versions and mismatched CSS.

source_navigation: Existing Ask Document source chips remain separate, with filename/page supplied by the API. They were not navigation buttons. No links supplied by the model become navigable. Knowledge Tools source buttons untouched.
private_data: Full backend answers, session tokens and fixture credentials retained only temporarily in ignored scratch; never sent to external services.
